name: metronome-lock-on
why: Chansey (set 227) calls Lock-On and then Mist through Metronome and faints. The Lock-On mark is still on the opponent at the replacement menu (docs/parity-mac/lock-on-mark-at-faint.md). Two turns later the opponent's Arbok enters with Intimidate against the player's Mist: nobody's Attack falls (docs/parity-mac/intimidate-against-mist.md). The Mist ends after its five turns.
